differences.current_text: Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, “May The LORD give you offspring from this woman for the petition which was asked of the LORD.” Then they went to their own home.

differences.current_text: Jonathan caused David to swear again, for the love that he had to him; for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
